title: Hospitality Crisis Diplomacy & Guest De-escalation

modules: 1. Anatomy of Guest Frustration & Empathy Triggers
2. The LAST Protocol in Real Hospitality Scenarios
3. Body Language, Vocal Cadence & Boundary Setting

quizQuestions.q: What does the "A" in the LAST hospitality recovery framework represent?
options: Apologize sincerely for the guest's distress without assigning blame
Ask the manager to intervene immediately

quizQuestions.q: When an agitated guest raises their voice in the lobby, the recommended verbal pace is:
options: Match their volume and pace so you are heard
Lower your tone, speak 15% slower, and maintain calm open body posture
Remain completely silent until they finish shouting
Immediately step backwards behind the security desk

quizQuestions.q: What is the maximum instant amenity voucher a Front Desk Host may authorize without GM signoff?
options: ₱2,500 F&B or Spa Voucher + Room Category Upgrade

quizQuestions.q: During de-escalation, which phrase should ALWAYS be avoided?
options: "I completely understand your frustration and I will personally solve this."
"That's not our hotel policy and there is nothing I can do."
"Let me see what alternatives I can immediately arrange for you."
"Thank you for bringing this to our attention right away."
